annotations.title: Find AI tools for a job

description: Find AI tools that fit a described job, from the INITE Atlas - over twenty thousand tools re-read every week, ranked by measured use rather than votes. Describe the job in a sentence or two with any constraint that matters (self-hosted, an API, a free plan, a budget, a product it must work with). Returns up to five tools, each complete for choosing: the price as read from its pricing page, how surely it fits the job, the way it runs and the budget (in words and as the judge's probability), its API and MCP server, whether it mentions a product you named, and what to check. Rank and recommend from this answer alone; call atlas_lookup only when the person asks for one tool's full record (price history, data policy, status). Free; twenty a day per address or account.

need.description: What the tool has to do, in plain prose, constraints in the same sentence, e.g. 'support email for a team of six, on our own server, under $100 a month'.
